d: Kali Puja in Shantipur, West Bengal, is steeped in history, devotion and Tantric traditions. At the heart of the celebrations is Agameshwari Kali, a revered form of Goddess Kali named after Tantric scholar Krishnananda Agambagish. Around 400 years ago, his grandson Sarvabhouma Agambagish established the goddess's idol in Shantipur. The puja rituals are described in the ancient text Brihat Tantrasara. One of the most distinctive aspects of the celebration is the Chakshudan ceremony, which marks the beginning of the worship. Watch
